text:
A beam of light is monochromatic.
What does monochromatic mean?
A
All the waves in the beam must have the same frequency only.
B
All the waves in the beam must have the same amplitude only.
C
All the waves in the beam must have the same speed only.
D
All the waves in the beam must have the same amplitude, frequency and speed.
